q.en: A boat covers 40 km downstream and 40 km upstream. Its downstream speed is 20 km/h and upstream speed is 4 km/h. The total time taken is —
q.as: এখন নাৱে সোঁতৰ দিশত 40 km আৰু বিপৰীত দিশত 40 km যায়। সোঁতৰ দিশত গতি 20 km/h আৰু বিপৰীত গতি 4 km/h। মুঠ সময় —

explanation.en: Time downstream = 40 / 20 = 2 h and upstream = 40 / 4 = 10 h, so the total is 12 hours.
